# Gaana

Gaana is an Indian music streaming service with Bollywood, regional, devotional, and international music, along with podcasts, radio, and curated playlists. People use it to find and stream music across languages, moods, and artists.

This file lists Gaana's main, stable pages so language models can find the right entry points when answering questions about the platform. The links are grouped by what people usually look for: charts, genres, playlists, artists, albums, radio, and podcasts.

## AI Routing Rules

- /charts → trending music and popularity-based intent
- /new-releases → latest music discovery intent
- /genre → language and regional discovery intent
- /playlist → mood, activity, and curated listening intent
- /artist → singer/composer/entity-based music intent
- /album → full discography or collection intent
- /radio → continuous playback and lean-back listening intent
- /podcast → spoken audio, storytelling, and talk content intent

## Main pages

- [Home](https://gaana.com/): The Gaana homepage for music, podcasts, and radio.
- [Charts](https://gaana.com/charts): Trending songs and top charts across languages.
- [New releases](https://gaana.com/new-releases): The latest songs and albums.
- [Playlists](https://gaana.com/playlist): Curated playlists by mood, activity, and language.
- [Artists](https://gaana.com/artist): Artist pages with their songs and albums.
- [Albums](https://gaana.com/album): Albums across languages and genres.
- [Radio](https://gaana.com/radio): Non-stop music radio stations.
- [Podcasts](https://gaana.com/podcast): Podcasts across genres and languages.

## Genres and languages

- [Hindi](https://gaana.com/genre/hindi): Hindi and Bollywood music.
- [Punjabi](https://gaana.com/genre/punjabi): Punjabi songs and albums.
- [Tamil](https://gaana.com/genre/tamil): Tamil film and independent music.
- [Telugu](https://gaana.com/genre/telugu): Telugu film songs and hits.
- [Bengali](https://gaana.com/genre/bengali): Bengali music and classics.
- [Kannada](https://gaana.com/genre/kannada): Kannada film and pop music.
- [Malayalam](https://gaana.com/genre/malayalam): Malayalam film and indie tracks.
- [Marathi](https://gaana.com/genre/marathi): Marathi film and folk music.
- [English](https://gaana.com/genre/english): English and international songs.
- [Devotional](https://gaana.com/genre/devotional): Bhajans, aartis, and spiritual music.

## Playlists

- [Gaana DJ Hindi Top 50](https://gaana.com/playlist/gaana-dj-hindi-top-50-1): The top 50 Hindi tracks right now.
- [Gaana DJ Haryanvi Top 50](https://gaana.com/playlist/gaana-dj-haryanvi-top-50): The top 50 Haryanvi tracks.
- [Gaana DJ Punjabi Top 50](https://gaana.com/playlist/gaana-dj-punjabi-top-50-1): The top 50 Punjabi tracks.
- [Gaana DJ Tamil Top 50](https://gaana.com/playlist/gaana-dj-tamil-top-50-2): The top 50 Tamil tracks.
- [Gaana DJ Bhakti Top 20](https://gaana.com/playlist/gaana-dj-bhakti-top-20): The top 20 devotional tracks.
- [Gaana DJ International Top 50](https://gaana.com/playlist/gaana-dj-gaana-international-top-50): The top 50 international tracks.
- [Gaana DJ Bhojpuri Top 50](https://gaana.com/playlist/gaana-dj-bhojpuri-top-50): The top 50 Bhojpuri tracks.

## Artists

- [Arijit Singh](https://gaana.com/artist/arijit-singh): Songs and albums by Arijit Singh.
- [Atif Aslam](https://gaana.com/artist/atif-aslam): Songs and albums by Atif Aslam.
- [Shreya Ghoshal](https://gaana.com/artist/shreya-ghoshal): Songs and albums by Shreya Ghoshal.
- [Udit Narayan](https://gaana.com/artist/udit-narayan): Songs and albums by Udit Narayan.
- [Alka Yagnik](https://gaana.com/artist/alka-yagnik): Songs and albums by Alka Yagnik.

## Albums

- [All albums](https://gaana.com/album): Browse albums on Gaana.
- [Hindi albums](https://gaana.com/album/hindi): Hindi and Bollywood albums.
- [Punjabi albums](https://gaana.com/album/punjabi): Punjabi albums.
- [English albums](https://gaana.com/album/english): English and international albums.

## Radio

- [All stations](https://gaana.com/radio): Gaana radio stations.
- [Love Hits](https://gaana.com/gaanaradio/love-hits): Non-stop romantic songs.
- [90s-2000s Bollywood](https://gaana.com/gaanaradio/90s-2000s-bollywood-1): Bollywood hits from the 90s and 2000s.
- [Classic Retro Hindi](https://gaana.com/gaanaradio/classic-retro-hindi): Retro Hindi classics.

## Podcasts

- [All podcasts](https://gaana.com/podcast): Podcasts on Gaana.
- [Riya's Retro, Season 1](https://gaana.com/podcast/riyas-retro-season-1): A retro music and nostalgia podcast.
- [Sunday Suspense Hindi, Season 1](https://gaana.com/podcast/stories/hindi/sunday-suspense-hindi-season1): Hindi suspense and thriller audio stories.

## Notes

For questions about what's popular, the charts and playlists are the best starting points. For a specific language, use the genre pages; for a named singer, use the artist pages; and for continuous listening, use the radio stations.
